name: route2-cml-tts
description: Fine-tune Route-2 v12 TTS on CML-TTS Portuguese shards stored in B2.
trainCmd: mkdir -p /root/r2_data /workspace/checkpoints "$SHARD_CACHE_DIR" && echo '[route2] PULL ROUTE2 BASE' && rclone copyto "$R2_BASE_CKPT" /root/r2_data/best.pt && rclone copyto "$R2_BASE_VOCAB" /root/r2_data/phon_vocab.json && ( while true; do sleep "${R2_SYNC_EVERY_SEC:-180}"; rclone copy /workspace/checkpoints "$R2_CKPT_DEST" --transfers 4 2>/dev/null && echo "MILESTONE CKPT_R2_SYNC $(date -u +%H:%M:%S)"; done ) & SYNC_PID=$!; if [ -n "${HF_SYNC_REPO:-}" ]; then ( while true; do sleep "${HF_SYNC_INTERVAL_SEC:-180}"; hf upload "$HF_SYNC_REPO" /workspace/checkpoints --repo-type model --path-in-repo "${HF_SYNC_PATH:-checkpoints}" --token "$HF_TOKEN" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "MILESTONE CKPT_HF_SYNC $(date -u +%H:%M:%S)" || true; done ) & HF_SYNC_PID=$!; else HF_SYNC_PID=''; fi; python trainer.py --data /root/r2_data --sharded_root "$R2_SHARDED_ROOT" --sharded_manifest "$R2_SHARDED_MANIFEST" --shard_cache_dir "$SHARD_CACHE_DIR" --shard_cache_max_gb "$SHARD_CACHE_MAX_GB" --resume /root/r2_data/best.pt --finetune --out /workspace/checkpoints --steps "$ROUTE2_STEPS" --batch "$ROUTE2_BATCH" --lr "$ROUTE2_LR" --bf16 --workers "$ROUTE2_WORKERS" --eval_every "${ROUTE2_EVAL_EVERY:-1000}" --eval_n "${ROUTE2_EVAL_N:-8}" --whisper "${ROUTE2_WHISPER:-base}" --patience "${ROUTE2_PATIENCE:-4}" --save_every "$ROUTE2_SAVE_EVERY" --log_every "$ROUTE2_LOG_EVERY"; RC=$?; kill "$SYNC_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; if [ -n "$HF_SYNC_PID" ]; then kill "$HF_SYNC_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; rclone copy /workspace/checkpoints "$R2_CKPT_DEST" --transfers 4 2>/dev/null && echo 'MILESTONE CKPT_R2_FINAL'; if [ -n "${HF_SYNC_REPO:-}" ]; then hf upload "$HF_SYNC_REPO" /workspace/checkpoints --repo-type model --path-in-repo "${HF_SYNC_PATH:-checkpoints}" --token "$HF_TOKEN" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'MILESTONE CKPT_HF_FINAL' || true; fi; exit "$RC"
